response.courseDescription: 103 Concepts in Chemistry Chemistry preparatory course for students who have not had high school chemistry or do not meet the prerequisites for CHEM 105.
response.coursePrerequisites: A minimum ALEKS math placement score of 45%, or concurrent enrollment in or credit for MATH 103, 105, 106, 108, 140, 171, 172, 182, 201, 202, ENGR 107, STAT 205 or 212.
